name: u/carol: lobby → PLAY → 5s countdown → TAP TO START → play possessions via play/defense pickers (rotates 1st/2nd/3rd choice)

steps._comment: Restarts dev server + re-attaches
Fresh app boot as carol

30s, not 15s: a production Reddit boot (JWT + remote assets over the network) is materially slower than the local emulator, and the previous 15s tripped on the post-reload boot while the very next step found the lobby fine.
Baseline for the post-game delta. Credits live on .lb2-ts-time (legacy class name — there is NO .lb2-ts-credits and no data-testid; see TitleStrip.jsx:175).
Reset the play-choice rotation counter for this run
Dismiss lobby FTUE coach if carol ever gets reset to FTUE
PLAY → casual matchmaking (NOT queue-btn-training, which is INSTANT and skips the countdown)

Build 0.0.35.18+ shows a queue picker (RANKED / TRAINING) on the PLAY tab instead of dropping straight into casual matchmaking — so the bnav-play click above is a no-op there (that tab is already active) and the match only starts from here. clickIfPresent keeps this a silent no-op on builds where PLAY starts matchmaking directly. RANKED, not TRAINING: TRAINING is instant and skips the tip-off countdown this test asserts.
Opponent locked; TIP-OFF countdown begins at 5
Must be lower than countStart — proves the countdown ticks
Countdown hit 0 → phase 'ready'
LAUNCH GAME
GameScene HUD mounted
STAT UPGRADE modal — blocks all play until dismissed

steps.expression: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid^="levelup-ability-"]'); window.__ups = (window.__ups ?? 0) + 1; return a ? a.getAttribute('data-testid') : ''; })()

steps._comment: CHOOSE AN UPGRADE → take the first ability
Mascot dialogue → dismiss
End-of-quarter recap → continue
Gate on the CONTINUE button itself — the summary root renders first, the button only after BTN_TICK frames
ISO submenu open → PG keeps the ball

steps.expression: (() => { const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="play-"]')].filter(e => e.getAttribute('data-testid') !== 'play-picker'); const enabled = all.filter(e => e.getAttribute('data-disabled') === '0'); const list = enabled.length ? enabled : all; const rot = window.__playRot ?? 0; const idx = list.length ? (rot % list.length) : 0; const p = list[idx] || list[0]; window.__plays = (window.__plays ?? 0) + 1; window.__playRot = rot + 1; return p ? p.getAttribute('data-testid') : ''; })()
steps._comment: Rotate 1st/2nd/3rd enabled choice each possession (repeat) so every play gets exercised, not just the first. 3rd slot is ISO -> its submenu is handled by the iso-mode branch above on the next tick.
CALL A PLAY

steps._comment: ASSERT: loop must have exited via game-over, not by exhausting max. Placed AFTER extract+screenshot so diagnostics are captured even when this fails.
Button is gated behind {tick >= BTN_TICK} (GameOverScreen.jsx:212) - renders only after the credits count-up finishes, so the root appearing is NOT enough.
CLAIM CREDITS -> fires onDismissGameOver -> game.end (credits + missions + roster XP). Without this the run never commits.
ASSERT: claim returns to lobby
let refreshUser() settle after game.end
Compare against preGameLobby. Credits selector is .lb2-ts-time — the old .lb2-ts-credits matched nothing and silently reported '?' every run.
ASSERT the credits element exists at all, so a future rename fails loudly instead of degrading to '?' in an extract that always passes.
